subject: Supplier activation: vendor setup, PO checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@riverton.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Riverton Procurement <procurement@riverton.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding materials and timeline request

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this up — Riverton is ready to get Redwood set up as an approved vendor. Could you please share your standard new-vendor packet (W-9 / tax forms, insurance, code of conduct, bank wiring instructions), PO template, and any contract redlines we should be aware of? We typically need:

- Official vendor packet PDF for our procurement file
- Purchase order template so our finance team can test mapping
- Key contacts for security and supplier risk (for our questionnaire)
- Expected lead time for first invoice after PO issuance

Target start date on our side is July 15 to have purchase order and invoice route validated. If you can send the materials and a short checklist of next steps today or tomorrow, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Sourcing Manager, Riverton Inc.
elena@riverton.com
Procurement | +1 415-555-0198

[Attachment: Riverton_Onboarding_Checklist_Request.txt]
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@riverton.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding materials and timeline request

Hi Elena — great to meet you. Welcome — we look forward to working with Riverton. I attached our new vendor packet and the PO template below. Quick summary and action items to hit your July 15 timeline: 

Attachments included:
- Redwood_New_Vendor_Packet_Riverton.pdf (company registration, insurance certs, W-9, bank wiring instructions)
- Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (sample PO fields and line-item examples)
- Redwood_Code_of_Conduct.pdf

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm the legal entity name and tax ID to appear on the PO (we prefer vendor name exactly as on W-9).
2) Confirm billing address and the invoice email to be used for automation (AP@riverton.com or a different alias).
3) If you require a PO change request window, let us know the routing time (we typically allow 3 business days for minor changes).
4) Tell us whether you need a signed supplier agreement before the first PO (we can provide a standard MS for signature).

Marcus / Stephanie — looping you both for the PO routing and invoice automation details (see PO_TEMPLATE). Marcus, note the invoicing cadence question above.

Elena — I can also kick off DocuSign for the supplier agreement if you confirm signatory details.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0110

[Attachments: Redwood_New_Vendor_Packet_Riverton.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB), Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB), Redwood_Code_of_Conduct.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding materials and timeline request

Laura / team — quick notes from finance on PO processing so we can give Riverton clear instructions:

- Required PO fields: vendor_code (we will provide), PO number (issued by Riverton), billing address, tax ID, net terms (default Net 30 unless negotiated), and line-item description matching Redwood_SKU when applicable.
- Invoicing: send PDFs to invoices@redwood.com; for automated parsing include the PO number in the subject line exactly as PO: ####.
- Vendor setup: finance needs a completed W-9 (US) or W-8/W-9 equivalent and bank routing details for EFT.
- If Riverton expects faster payment, we can review early-pay options but need procurement approval.

Attaching a routing diagram we use internally for PO acceptance and exceptions — helps to set SLAs. I can generate the vendor_code once Elena confirms legal entity and tax ID.

Marcus Lin
Finance Operations Manager
marcus@redwood.com

[Attachment: PO_Routing_Diagram.png (PNG, 85KB)]
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@riverton.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Riverton Procurement <procurement@riverton.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding materials and timeline request

Laura / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the packet. A few follow-ups from our side:

- Legal entity for the PO should be: Redwood Inference, Inc. — EIN 26-1234567 (confirm this matches your W-9).
- AP email for invoices is ap-invoices@riverton.com. We will test a sample PO this week.
- We have a short supplier security questionnaire (attached) — who should our security team contact at Redwood?
- For bank details, please do not paste sensitive account info in email; use the secure page or attach via DocuSign.

Can you also point me to the DocuSign link for the MS and supplier agreement? Once we get answers on the security questionnaire and the PO test, we will issue the initial PO.

Thanks,
Elena

[Attachment: Riverton_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@riverton.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding materials and timeline request

Elena — thanks, confirmed: Redwood Inference, Inc. matches the W-9 in the packet.

Next steps and contacts:
- DocuSign supplier agreement: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/SUPPLIER/EXAMPLE_LINK (we will send the envelope directly to the signatory you provide).
- Bank details: we will provide wiring instructions inside the DocuSign envelope for secure transfer (no account info in email).
- Security questionnaire: Priyom Das (applied-ml & risk) will own the Riverton security questionnaire and coordinate evidence. Priyom — can you review the attached PDF and advise which artifacts (SOC 2 report, data retention policy, network diagram) we should share?
- Marcus — once Elena confirms entity/tax ID, please generate the vendor_code and share the PO acceptance window.

Elena — we will aim to complete the DocuSign + security review by July 10 so you can issue a test PO ahead of your July 15 target. Let me know the signatory name and email for DocuSign and we’ll route it today.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
